name: 10y Paraíso: Scam Dust
description: For techno and underground house fans, Gare Porto is the place to be. This Friday, the iconic club celebrates 10 years of Paraíso with a lineup featuring Scam Dust (Tiago & Shcuro).
longDescription:
Gare Porto marks a decade of its Paraíso event series on September 11, 2026, with a special edition featuring Scam Dust. This anniversary celebration highlights the club's long-standing commitment to electronic music, presenting a lineup that includes the duo Tiago and Shcuro. Paraíso has consistently showcased artists within the techno and underground house genres, establishing itself as a key fixture in Porto's nightlife landscape.

Attendees can expect an evening dedicated to electronic music within Gare Porto's distinctive setting. The club is known for its industrial aesthetic and powerful sound system, creating an immersive atmosphere for its audience. The event caters to those interested in extended sets and a focused clubbing experience, typically attracting a crowd familiar with the genre and the venue's programming.

Admission to the 10y Paraíso event is ticketed. Gare Porto is located near Campanhã, accessible via the Campanhã metro and train station, approximately a 10-minute walk. Bus routes also serve the area, providing connections from various parts of the city.
